rawContent: I cover what sexual harassment is, some of my personal experiences, and how Cuomo’s story relates to all of us in healthcare. My two goals were to convince the audience that SH is about power, not sex, and that #MeToo has not gone far enough yet. Was I successful?

I had decided not to do a post- poll (asking whether #metoo has gone too far) because I didn’t want to be sad that no one’s mind had been changed. But the audience requested a repeat and, lo and behold, a lot of people changed their responses! 

NGL, I was delighted to see that!
